introduction: Discover the Caverns of Armageddon, meet the Hunters and follow fifteen independent bounties, the prisoner’s two companies, Blicatch’s four creature parts and the Dragon Queen’s two-amulet upgrade. Source clues explain actual locks, containers, secret routes and foreign follow-ups; accepted named exchanges remain separate from the wider campaign.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible NPC encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. First discovery is its own achievement. Reading hints and current material checks award no credit.

The forest connects to the Jade Empire surface. Xavier’s forest portal reaches the Myrabolus observatory backroom; its destination still has a sealed door. The native west forest boundary is not reciprocal with the inbound surface edge, so a return route must be qualified separately.

The mercenary camp’s fifteen bounties are independent. Ask each actual recipient orc or orcs for lore; keyword questions do not themselves record achievements. Most recipients are fixed, but Clond and Redana can move. Roland has a valid bounty recipe but no active declared reset placement in the scanned world; resolve his availability before assigning the Maximas bounty as a daily. Starting-room clues are not evidence of a current actor.

The ordinary shaft entrance requires the steel key carried by its elite orc. Graiven’s closed blood basin contains the chipped rock key for the locked east steps beyond Veannan. The guard captain has the stone key for the general cavern’s locked east entrance. These keys have zero normal-unlock break chance; current possession is optional route guidance, not proof of opening or arrival.

Proofs are loaded NPC inventory objects, not automatically severed heads or generated death callbacks. Scralack’s head comes from the Jade Empire’s strike-force general. Exact loose-carried kinds are required; equipped, held, nested or merely similar proof does not satisfy the native offering search. Supplied proof is accepted without a personal kill or original-source history.

Open the wounded Myrabolan soldier, dying Soldier of Fortune or dying Wild Card container as appropriate to recover two different company-tag kinds. These are object containers, not wounded NPC healing or escort missions. The prisoner exchange has no native disappearance command even though its prose describes leaving.

Blicatch’s secret stone entrance leads into a chamber whose northern return is blocked; continue south into the ogre station for the ordinary route. Archangel wings have a one-charge GET/PUT sleep trap; an attempted pickup can trigger sleep without recovering the wings. A wyvern wing is not a substitute.

The archangel, behemoth, beholder and Krazzi’s following fire elemental supply Blicatch’s four different parts. His accepted reward gives both amulets and retires him. Reset mode one permits native repeatable classification but does not prove a currently admitted NPC or replacement materials.

The Dragon Queen combines one kilospanatis amulet and one hazy blue amulet into the cosmos amulet. Her native acceptance does not require your Blicatch history. Alexis in Myrabolus can supply the hazy blue amulet for a treasure chest. Earlier receipts do not recreate consumed amulets.

Argophel’s lair is below the secret grate at the golem intersection. Maximas is below the secret waterfall passage. The general’s rift uses ENTER and reaches the downward spiral; no ordinary reverse portal is declared there. Defeating Endosa is lore and a bounty source, not an enforced receipt prerequisite for entering.

Maverick and Abbadon share the throne room. The secret rescue ladder goes up to the Sunweaver; the reverse descent into the throne room is blocked. From the airship’s other ladder descend to the forest, with no ordinary ascent back. These static routes do not certify rescuing actors or winning a campaign.

Abbadon’s cosmos key opens both the secret temple vault wall and the locked, pickproof statue in Ajax’s part of the forest. Its normal-unlock break chance is one hundred percent. One successful use can consume a key, so do not assume the same physical key opens both locks; renewed or shared supply requires qualification. The Soulsword is in the vault; the ring of abnormal power is in the statue. Neither is a local accepted quest terminal.

The Sunweaver has four treasure-chest object placements in two rooms, subject to their shared cap. They are quest objects, not openable containers. Myrabolus recipients Rico, Random, Decker and Alexis accept chests for separate rewards. The lost monkey atop the redwood goes to Myrabolus’s monkey hunter; Abbadon’s heart goes to the Sky City of Ultarium’s dwarven trapper. Foreign receipts remain credited to their real zones.

Imported epic rune and memory objects in the general’s rift chamber use their existing systems. The magical fountain in the throne room uses a rotating spell pool on DRINK; it is not an escape portal or accepted quest. Existing settlement and effects need committed outcome integration, not another payout or invented keyword credit.

All eighteen native exchanges remain separate named outcomes. All retain native daily shape, including Blicatch under reset mode one. Actual difficulty, source-generation admission, current stock, secret access, traps, group eligibility and renewal still need qualification before daily assignment. Active accounting refuses legacy item resets without admitted generation.

The sources contain broader claims about exorcising Maverick, immortal Hunters, army defeat, delayed rescue and using the Soulsword against gods. No local assigned procedure or shipped trigger establishes those campaign transitions. Record these as future builder-selected objectives, with committed events and clear scope, before claiming a completed campaign.

stories.title: Blicatch’s four creature parts
stories.summary: Reach Blicatch through the secret stone entrance off the magically forged tunnels. Recover the archangel wings, behemoth tooth, beholder eyestalk and fire-elemental tendril: four different kinds. Offer all four for two amulets and Blicatch’s departure. Reset mode one retains native repeatable shape, but actual renewal and admitted supply need qualification.

steps.text: Carry a pair archangel wings

stories.title: The Dragon Queen’s cosmos amulet
stories.summary: Offer the amulet of kilospanatis and a hazy, blue amulet together to the Dragon Queen for the amulet of the cosmos. Blicatch produces both; Alexis in Myrabolus can also give the hazy blue amulet for a Sunweaver treasure chest. Supplied amulets fit without a personal Blicatch receipt. Both inputs are consumed; earlier acceptance does not restore them.

steps.text: Earlier Blicatch exchange recorded
